A horrific equidae skull creature called "Long Horse" starts terrorizing the workers of a nearby factory with horrifying vision of bright light shooting into the sky. The SCP Foundation sends two of their best operatives to try to understand these visions, and prevent the upcoming tragedy.
This is not the canonical story of Long Horse. Long Horse was created by Trevor Henderson and is not officially part of the SCP universe. On one strange fourth of July weekend, the ThrillZone amusement park experienced an absurdly high number of deaths caused by various anomalous properties. The park's creepy mascot, Happy the Hippo, seemed to lead the charge. But other deaths were caused by the tunnel of love, roller coasters, a Ferris wheel and a clown... Later deemed SCP-823, this dangerous place still has the Foundation debating over it's classification and means of containment.
